review: Reviewed the complete new LocalMusicStudio component and suite, selected page/registry deltas and their exact call sites, account-scope helper and music command/state contract. Legacy page, StemDaw and knowledge-store retained code is not claimed as freshly qualified in full; the latter two match their public preview bytes.

The Noise Gen entry opens local music, with an explicit Legacy library switch. Local music uses native state/configuration/import/grant/submit/export/revoke commands. Browser-library import copies only the selected bounded file; paired-chat lookup does not itself approve a music session. Native dialogs, grants, runtime custody and process limits remain authoritative.

Runtime fix 38 retires account-bound studio state and guards asynchronous continuations before and after native/library/binding reads. Late state or command completion cannot continue under a successor account. Ordered state reads retain the newest requested snapshot. Recipes now recompute when runtime or model references change for the same project.

Three failures were reproduced before the fix: stale account state, old command follow-up and stale recipe runtime/model references. Nine mocked tests now cover those cases, same-profile draft retention, account round trip, unmount, ordered reads, grant gating and typed recipe submission.

Stopping/revoking remains explicit. Closing the UI does not claim to unload a running model, revoke a native grant or undo an already accepted operation. No native model, file import, GPU job, model download or real grant was run during this review.
limits: Unfrozen unpublished source proposal; fix 38 and earlier post-R380 changes remain uninstalled.

Shared local-music recipe/protocol contracts and native/domain services remain separately scoped dependencies, absent from this web preview. Canonical tests use those current contracts and a mocked native bridge.
Local ACE-Step/Demucs setup, hardware/resource admission, audio quality, file custody, native consent and installed multi-account operation require their separate acceptance evidence.
The legacy library remains available but was not freshly exercised end to end. Browser-library asynchronous import and real native asset URL lifecycle are not fully qualified by these nine tests.
Compilation externalizes npm and separately scoped source. No full application typecheck, music-model license acceptance or signed release claim.
Five intentional support-contact matches elsewhere remain for exact public-candidate owner review.
